answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can work like a long voyage where every crew member carries a ferrous badge forged only after completing real, costly deliveries, and a prism-like public ledger splits each badge's history into verifiable colors any peer can inspect. One captain can claim a thousand sailors, but forging a thousand voyages, badges, and delivery trails costs real fuel and time, so fake fleets stay small while genuine crews keep sailing.
